name: hints-updater
description: HTTP 103 Early Hints updater - captures origin responses and updates EdgeKV with Last-Modified tracking

scripts.package: npm run package:bundle && npm run package:vendor && npm run package:tarball
scripts.package:bundle: mkdir -p built && jq -n --arg version "$npm_package_version" --arg desc "$npm_package_description" '{"edgeworker-version": $version, "description": $desc}' > built/bundle.json
scripts.package:tarball: mkdir -p dist && cd built && tar czf ../dist/hints-updater_$npm_package_version.tgz *
scripts.activate:staging: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGEGRID_SECTION:-$npm_package_config_edgerc_section}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${HINTS_UPDATER_EWID:-$npm_package_config_ewid}" staging $npm_package_version'
scripts.activate:production: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGEGRID_SECTION:-$npm_package_config_edgerc_section}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${HINTS_UPDATER_EWID:-$npm_package_config_ewid}" production $npm_package_version'
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run package && npm run upload && npm run activate:staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run package && npm run upload && npm run activate:production
